# RetiredPageNotice

Tells someone who followed an old route or link that the page moved (and where, as a link in the destination module's colour) or that it is retired with no rep…

`SongNodes.RetiredPageNotice` · Pages

## Use

```jsx
<SongNodes.RetiredPageNotice kind="moved" oldPath="…" reason="…" />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="SongNodes.RetiredPageNotice" kind="moved" old-path="…" reason="…"></x-import>
```

## Props (RetiredPageNoticeProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `kind` * | `"moved" \| "retired"` | moved = has a new place; retired = no replacement (410 after the grace period). |
| `oldPath` * | `string` | Old route or file, shown in mono. |
| `reason` * | `string` | One sentence: what changed and why. |
| `destination` | `{ module: string; label: string; href: string }` | New place (moved only); the link takes this module's colour. |
| `changedOn` * | `string` | Date it moved or was retired. |
| `noticeUntil` * | `string` | End of the 90-day notice period; then 301 (moved) or 410 (retired). |
| `allowSkip` | `boolean` | Per-device opt-in to skip the notice; off by default, no countdown. |
